scope: Original corpse-removal hooks, player placement, rider callbacks and additional creature lifecycle decisions

additional_cases: Thrown Bunny landing attracts nearby native monsters and preserves distant targets
BigCat and Fish juvenile maturity thresholds preserve distinct original flags
Mouse climbs a native stone wall through its original ladder predicate

additional_effect_cases: Lawyer constructs a controlled loaded jail and teleports the real native player
Camel native rider-placement dispatch preserves original seat coordinates and eye normalization
EvilScientist transformation increases original/native health and summons two original EvilSnowmen
Original position/pitch edits merge with unrelated native X/Z/yaw changes; read-only views preserve native movement
additional_lifecycle_cases: Native fatal Hotdog damage and corpse removal create exactly one original Tombstone; LifeGem consumes one and restores pet stats
ArmyGuy health thresholds spawn one of each original limb; original lifetime expiration removes body parts

shared_regressions_reproduced_before_fix: Lawyer jail block construction succeeded but the real player did not move
Native rider positioning skipped original Camel seat callback
Native final corpse removal bypassed original markDead and created no pet tombstone
admission_regression: Newly implemented rider APIs are admitted; unrelated unsupported original overrides remain rejected.
generic_mod_identity_guard: passed:252 production/loader files; no content-mod dispatch added
build_fixture_policy: Actual-mod JUnit tests remain opt-in; runtime original-mod fixtures require entitySelfTest and skip absent mods.
limitations: No live GPU/client gameplay replay of this batch.
Jail test uses a controlled previously selected site; initial terrain suitability and randomized jail loot are not certified.
Hosted vehicle placement is exercised; native-carrier attachment offsets and broader client poses remain unverified.
Roster and selected specialized callbacks do not establish every AI branch or full spawning ecology.
